title: Committee of Supply – Head Q (Ministry of Communications and Information)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head Q (Ministry of Communications and Information)

sections.label: ICM jobs and workers
sections.summary: MCI expects the sector to create over 13,000 PMET jobs and have more than 210,000 ICM workers by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Communications and Information (MCI) anticipates that this sector will create more than 13,000 professionals, managers, executives and technicians (PMET) level jobs and have more than 210,000 infocomm media (ICM) workers by 2020.

sections.label: Industry digital plans and SME hubs
sections.summary: Examples include industry digital plans for logistics and retail in 2017, and an SME digital tech hub and SME solutions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Examples include the industry digital plans launched for the logistics and retail sectors in 2017, while at the small and medium enterprises (SME) level, the SME digital tech hub and solutions for SMEs have been set up.

sections.label: Driving ICM innovation and commercialisation
sections.summary: The sector needs help driving innovation, productising local ICM solutions and achieving commercialisation in deep technology areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: In particular, we need to help drive innovation in the sector and help our local ICM companies productise solutions and enable them to achieve greater commercialisation, especially in deep technology, in areas, such as artificial intelligence (AI), financial technology (fintech), urban solutions and cybersecurity.

sections.label: Cybersecurity Bill and ecosystem
sections.summary: The Bill aims to strengthen cybersecurity defences, especially critical information infrastructure, and asks how Government can promote a cybersecurity ecosystem.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: The Bill aims to strengthen our nation’s cybersecurity defences, especially those involving critical information infrastructure (CII).

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: How can the Government help promote the development of a sustainable and vibrant cybersecurity ecosystem, including cybersecurity startups?

sections.label: SMEs and workers digital help
sections.summary: It asks the Ministry's plans to help SMEs join the digital wave and ways to encourage workers not to miss opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: In this regard, what are the Ministry's plans and efforts to help, especially SMEs, so that they can move quicker to join the digital wave?

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: For workers, what ways are being done and will be done to encourage them so that they will not miss out on the possibilities and opportunities that may come?

sections.label: Data access and privacy laws
sections.summary: It asks whether the Minister will revisit privacy laws to balance data abuse against using datasets for legitimate analysis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cedric Foo Chee Keng (Pioneer)
sentences.text: For machine learning and AI to thrive, one would need datasets.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cedric Foo Chee Keng (Pioneer)
sentences.text: We have a small population and our privacy laws, as they currently stand, do not make for easy access to data.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cedric Foo Chee Keng (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Data are also collected and stored separately even within different branches of Government and not freely shared.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cedric Foo Chee Keng (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Could the Minister lay out his plans to revisit our privacy laws to strike the right balance against data abuse even as we allow for datasets to be used for analysis for legitimate enterprise or Government applications?

sections.label: Merging IDA and MDA
sections.summary: The passage states that merging IDA and MDA was a forward-looking move to better position the joint entity for a fast-changing environment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: As technology continues to advance, we can only imagine that such threats will continue to grow.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: It was, therefore, a forward-looking move to merge the Infocomm Development Authority (IDA) and the Media Development Authority (MDA) to better position the joint entity to deal with the fast-changing environment.

sections.label: Cybersecurity survey findings
sections.summary: A CSA-commissioned survey found one in three respondents did not manage passwords securely and many skipped virus scans and used open wi-fi.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: The Cyber Security Agency (CSA) commissioned a survey last year to find out Singaporean attitudes to cybersecurity.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: It was discovered that one in three respondents did not manage their passwords securely.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: For almost half the survey respondents, they did not conduct virus scans on their devices and files and used open, non-password protected wi-fi networks in public places.

sections.label: SME digitalisation adoption rate
sections.summary: Since SMEs Go Digital launched last year, only a few hundred SMEs adopted digital technology using 30 of 56 pre-approved IMDA solutions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: The benefits of digitalisation to the economy are apparent.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: However, when we look at the rate of adoption of digitalisation by SMEs in Singapore, since the SMEs Go Digital Programme was launched last year, only a few hundred SMEs have adopted digital technology using 30 out of the 56 pre-approved solutions by IMDA.

sections.label: Industry Digital Plans for sectors
sections.summary: IMDA highlighted it would develop sector-specific Industry Digital Plans for six priority sectors: Retail, Logistics, Food Services, Wholesale Trade, Cleaning and Security.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: IMDA has highlighted that it would develop sector-specific Industry Digital Plans (IDP) for six priority sectors, namely, Retail, Logistics, Food Services, Wholesale Trade, Cleaning and Security.

sections.label: Enquiry on sectors and timeline
sections.summary: The passage asks how the six priority sectors were arrived at and what the envisaged timeline of the rollout is.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Further, I would like to enquire how the six priority sectors were arrived at and what is the envisaged timeline of the rollout?

sections.label: SMEs Go Digital launch
sections.summary: Since the last Budget, the Government launched SMEs Go Digital to help SMEs build stronger digital capabilities to secure growth in the digital economy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Since the last Budget, the Government has also launched SMEs Go Digital to help them build stronger digital capabilities so as to secure growth in the digital economy.

sections.label: SMEs Go Digital programme update
sections.summary: The passage asks the Minister to update the House on the SMEs Go Digital programme and how it has met its objectives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Can the Minister provide the House an update on the SMEs Go Digital programme so far and how has it been meeting its objectives?

sections.label: TeSA Accelerator update
sections.summary: The passage asks the Minister to provide an update on the TeSA Accelerator.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Can the Minister provide an update on the TeSA Accelerator?

sections.label: Adolescent cyberbullying study findings
sections.summary: A 2014 study by the Singapore Children's Society and IMH found one in nine adolescents said they were cyberbullying victims.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Chairman, Sir, a 2014 study done by the Singapore Children's Society and the Institute of Mental Health (IMH) found that one in nine adolescents said they have been victims of cyberbullying.

sections.label: Limited Council website resources
sections.summary: The passage states the Council website has limited resources, with no dedicated helpline, support network, parent and teacher resources, or reporting channels.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: However, the resources available on the Council website are limited.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: There is no dedicated helpline, no support network or resources for parents and teachers and no channels for victims to submit cyberbullying reports.

sections.label: People at heart of digital transformation
sections.summary: The passage states that people are at the heart of the digital transformation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: Chairman, people are at the heart of the digital transformation.

sections.label: Workers needing transition assistance
sections.summary: The passage states some workers will transition seamlessly, but a fair number, especially mature workers, will need assistance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: Some workers will make the transition fairly seamlessly, but a fair number, especially the mature workers, will need assistance.

sections.label: Analogue TV switch-off and digital readiness
sections.summary: Analogue TV channels switch off on 31 December 2018, and a 3P Workgroup studies digital readiness to help Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: The existing analogue TV channels will be switched off on 31 December 2018 and all Mediacorp TV channels will be broadcast in digital format only.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: As such, I urge the Ministry to put in more efforts to highlight the importance of getting ready for the ending of analogue TV signal broadcasting.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: To increase awareness, is it possible for blank screens to be broadcast on the analogue TV signals followed by the necessary info-commercial messages to teach users what needs to be done to receive the digital TV signals?

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: In August 2017, there is the 3P Workgroup to study the issues of digital readiness.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: The aim is to deliver a blueprint of strategies to help Singaporeans, especially the more vulnerable, understand and enjoy the benefits of technology.

sections.label: Silver Infocomm Initiative
sections.summary: The Silver Infocomm Initiative has reached over 130,000 senior citizens to promote IT awareness and literacy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: The Silver Infocomm Initiative is one good example, which has reached out to more than 130,000 senior citizens to promote IT awareness and literacy.

sections.label: Blueprint timing and Government cooperation
sections.summary: The speaker asks when the blueprint will be ready and how Government will work with businesses and community.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: Can I ask the Minster when will the blueprint be ready?

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: How will the Government work with businesses and the community to take this effort forward to help all, not just seniors, as well as low-income families and their children?

sections.label: New York Times subscription revenue
sections.summary: The New York Times announced over US$1 billion in subscription revenue in 2017 and added 157,000 digital subscriptions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Indeed, it has just announced that it made more than US$1 billion in overall subscription revenue in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: While other media companies are struggling, The New York Times saw its circulation surge, adding 157,000 digital subscriptions in just the fourth quarter of 2017 alone.

sections.label: Mentoring scheme for young journalists
sections.summary: The speaker suggests newsrooms consider a structured mentoring scheme to develop and guide younger journalists.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: While the actual effectiveness of using young journalists to attract young readers warrants an in-depth study, I would like to suggest that newsrooms consider a structured and coordinated mentoring scheme to help develop and guide the younger journalists.

sections.label: Quality journalism and mainstream media credibility
sections.summary: A renewed focus on quality journalism will reinforce mainstream media credibility and grow readership.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: A renewed focus on quality journalism – which was the strategy of the New York Times – will reinforce the credibility of our mainstream media and result in growing readership.

sections.label: Mediacorp quality, partnerships, mergers
sections.summary: Mediacorp emphasises quality and needs more partnerships, amid major broadcast mergers and a Channel 5 co-production with Thailand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Programmes, such as "Insight", also deserve mention for their investigative journalism.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: But while Mediacorp is putting the emphasis on quality and seeing positive results, it also needs to foster more partnerships to thrive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: We have already seen some major mergers in the broadcast and film arena: the Disney and Fox merger is among the biggest.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: One recent partnership was the Channel 5 drama "Missing", a first-ever co-production with Thailand.

sections.label: Tokyo Olympics broadcast rights
sections.summary: The speaker agrees with the Minister that sports rights, especially marquee events like the Olympics, are getting more expensive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Lastly, Sir, my favourite topic – the broadcast rights for the Tokyo Olympics in 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I agree with the Minister that sports rights are getting more expensive, particularly for marquee events like the Olympics.

sections.label: Rio Olympics telecast rescheduling
sections.summary: Singaporeans were grateful for the last-minute Rio Olympics telecast deal, but the hurried rescheduling of programming is not ideal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Thirdly, while Singaporeans were grateful for the last-minute deal to telecast the Rio Olympics two years ago, the hurried rescheduling of programming is not ideal.

sections.label: Mediacorp partnership with pay platforms
sections.summary: The speaker suggests Mediacorp could partner long-term with pay platforms StarHub and Singtel to pursue these rights together.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ganesh Rajaram (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Perhaps this could be the opportunity for Mediacorp to embark on a long-term partnership with pay platforms StarHub and Singtel to go after these rights together.

sections.label: ICM ITM growth and jobs
sections.summary: The ICM ITM is expected to achieve around 6% compound annual growth and create more than 13,000 PMET jobs by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: The ICM ITM is expected to achieve a compound annual growth rate of around 6% for the industry and create more than 13,000 PMET jobs by 2020.

sections.label: Libraries as lifelong learning centres
sections.summary: Over 26 million people visit the 26 libraries yearly, but adult borrowing has not increased, so libraries should become active lifelong learning centres.

sentences.speaker: Dr Teo Ho Pin
sentences.text: More 26 million people visit our 26 libraries yearly.

sentences.speaker: Dr Teo Ho Pin
sentences.text: Despite that, the number of adults who visit the library and borrow books for their own reading and learning has not been increasing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Teo Ho Pin
sentences.text: We need to transform our 26 libraries into "active lifelong learning centres" to further encourage reading and learning among Singaporeans.

sections.label: Revised guillotine time for MCI
sections.summary: The guillotine time for Head Q, Ministry of Communications and Information, is revised to 11.40 am.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: In view of the Statement made in Parliament earlier on and the amount of time used, I will now revise the guillotine time for Head Q – Ministry of Communications and Information to 11.40 am.

sections.label: Thanks to Members for comments
sections.summary: The speaker thanks Members for their kind comments made yesterday.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, first of all, I would like to thank Members for their kind comments yesterday.

sections.label: Microsoft study on digital economy
sections.summary: A Microsoft study estimated the digital economy would add US$10 billion to GDP by 2021.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Microsoft's recent study estimated that the digital economy would contribute another US$10 billion to our gross domestic product (GDP) by 2021.

sections.label: SMEs Go Digital Programme launch
sections.summary: The SMEs Go Digital Programme was launched last year, focusing on key sectors where digital technologies can improve productivity.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: This is particularly true for SMEs which sometimes lack the resources and scale to deploy digital solutions.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: That is why we launched the SMEs Go Digital Programme last year, which, for a start, focuses on key sectors where digital technologies can improve productivity significantly.

sections.label: SMEs benefiting from programme
sections.summary: More than 650 SMEs have benefited from the programme, with many more waiting in line.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: More than 650 SMEs have benefited from the programme, with many more waiting in line.

sections.label: House of Seafood growth
sections.summary: House of Seafood can now export more easily, with sales up 20% and productivity up 25%.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: House of Seafood is now able to export its products more easily, and has grown its sales by 20% and productivity by 25%.

sections.label: Vehicle accident reduction data
sections.summary: Analysing collected data reduced vehicle accidents by 50%.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: By analysing the data collected, it was able to significantly reduce the number of vehicle accidents by 50%.

sections.label: Logistics e-Cargo platform
sections.summary: IMDA works with logistics companies on a cloud-based e-Cargo Consolidation Platform to lower freight costs for SME freight forwarders, launching in April with over 100 SMEs.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: For example, in the logistics sector, the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA), is working with major logistics companies, such as Bollore Logistics, Dimerco and LCH Lockton, to lead their SME clients through the digitalisation process using a cloud-based e-Cargo Consolidation Platform.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: This aggregates freight demands, thereby lowering freight costs for SME freight forwarders.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: This initiative will be launched in April and, for a start, over 100 SMEs are expected to benefit from this project.

sections.label: Kampong Glam retail digitalisation
sections.summary: SPRING Singapore, SMCCI and One Kampong Glam Association collaborate to develop Kampong Glam into Singapore's first digitally enabled retail neighbourhood.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: As part of our efforts in the retail sector, we are collaborating with the Standards, Productivity and Innovation Board (SPRING) Singapore, the Singapore Malay Chambers of Commerce and Industry (SMCCI), and One Kampong Glam Association to develop Kampong Glam into Singapore’s first digitally enabled retail neighbourhood.

sections.label: ITM jobs and value-added
sections.summary: Under the ITM, 13,000 new PMET jobs are targeted and industry value-added is expected to grow around 6% annually.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Under our ITM, we aim to create 13,000 new professionals, managers, executives and technicians (PMET) jobs, and the industry’s value-added is expected to grow at around 6% annually.

sections.label: Open Innovation Platform pilot
sections.summary: IMDA will pilot the Open Innovation Platform, a crowdsourcing platform for problem owners and solution providers to co-develop digital solutions.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: This might not be that easy with digitalisation blurring the lines among sectors, which creates the need to solve problems that cut across many sectors and disciplines.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, IMDA will pilot the Open Innovation Platform, which is a crowdsourcing platform to facilitate collaboration between problem owners and a community of solution providers, to co-develop digital solutions that address actual business problems.

sections.label: Four frontier technology areas
sections.summary: Investment was announced in four frontier technology areas: data analytics and AI, IoT, cybersecurity and immersive media.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Last year, I announced that we will invest in developing deeper capabilities in four frontier technology areas, namely, data analytics and AI, IoT, cybersecurity and immersive media.

sections.label: Programme support and first trainees
sections.summary: The Programme has received overwhelming support and its first batch of 20 trainees will start training in May.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: To date, the Programme has received overwhelming support and the first batch of 20 trainees will start training in May.

sections.label: Singapore cybersecurity sector growth
sections.summary: Cybersecurity in Singapore is a fast-growing sector with potential to generate $900 million in revenue by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Cybersecurity in Singapore is a fast-growing sector, with the potential to generate $900 million in revenue by 2020.

sections.label: CSA proof of concept funding
sections.summary: CSA will introduce a Co-Innovation and Development Proof of Concept Funding Scheme for cybersecurity solutions for national security, critical infrastructure and classified system users.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Second, CSA will introduce a Co-Innovation and Development Proof of Concept Funding Scheme to support the development of cybersecurity solutions for national security, critical infrastructure and classified system users.

sections.label: Training places taken up
sections.summary: Over 27,000 training places have been taken up or committed, as Minister Heng Swee Keat mentioned in his Budget Statement.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: As Minister Heng Swee Keat mentioned in his Budget Statement, over 27,000 training places have been taken up or committed.

sections.label: Cybersecurity professional and training places
sections.summary: He is now a cybersecurity professional working for NCS, and another 20,000 training places will be created by 2020, including in manufacturing and professional services.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: He is now a cybersecurity professional working for NCS.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: This will create another 20,000 training places by 2020, including in new sectors like manufacturing and professional services.

sections.label: IMDA harmonising telecom and broadcast approaches
sections.summary: IMDA has been studying how to harmonise telecommunications and broadcast approaches in competition, consumer protection and resilience, believing a converged code will provide clarity and minimise regulatory overheads while protecting the public interest.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: IMDA has been studying very carefully how to harmonise the approaches for the telecommunications and broadcast sectors in areas, such as competition, consumer protection and resilience.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We believe that a converged competition and consumer protection code will provide clarity to industry, minimise regulatory overheads, while continuing to protect the public interest.

sections.label: Deferring Broadcasting Act review
sections.summary: MCI will be deferring the review of the Broadcasting Act.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: MCI will thus be deferring the review of the Broadcasting Act.

sections.label: APEC privacy certification application approved
sections.summary: Singapore's application to join the APEC Cross Border Privacy Rules and Privacy Recognition for Processors systems was approved on 20 February 2018.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Last year, I announced our intention to join the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Cross Border Privacy Rules and Privacy Recognition for Processors systems, two multilateral certification mechanisms to promote cross-border data flows.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: I am pleased to announce that our application was approved on 20 February 2018.

sections.label: Digital Readiness Workgroup blueprint strategies
sections.summary: A digital readiness blueprint sets out digital access, digital literacy and digital participation for every Singaporean.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Mr Saktiandi Supaat asked about the Digital Readiness Workgroup and its proposed strategies to improve digital readiness among Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We have set out a digital readiness blueprint to give every Singaporean digital access, which is the means to transact digitally; digital literacy – the skills, attitudes and values of a digital citizen; and digital participation – the ability to make use of technology to improve daily life.

sections.label: Digital Readiness Workgroup and Blueprint
sections.summary: The Digital Readiness Workgroup was established last year and a Digital Readiness Blueprint will be published later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Government, businesses and the community must work together to have a deep and wide impact for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: This is why we established the Digital Readiness Workgroup last year, bringing together representatives from the public, people and private sectors to propose strategies to address future opportunities and challenges.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We have learnt a lot from hearing about these organisations’ approaches to building literacy and giving people a chance to participate in the digital world.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We will publish a Digital Readiness Blueprint later this year.

sections.label: Smartphone ownership and access
sections.summary: Smartphone ownership in Singapore is about 150% of the population, yet some Singaporeans have no access to a smartphone.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Today, the total ownership of smartphones in Singapore is high, at about 150% of the population, and yet, there are Singaporeans who have no access to a smartphone.

sections.label: Training in four languages
sections.summary: Training for these basic skills will be provided in all four languages by the end of the year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: To ensure that everyone can benefit from this, we will provide training for these basic skills in all four languages by the end of the year.

sections.label: Digital clinics and TV assistance
sections.summary: Digital clinics, learning journeys and the Digital TV Assistance Scheme are organised to help seniors and households adopt digital technology and Digital TV.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: By the end of this year, we would have organised more than 50 digital clinics for 2,000 seniors, to help them become confident in using digital mobile technology.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: This year, we will also work with industry and community groups to organise 48 experiential learning journeys to benefit 2,000 seniors to learn about digital technologies useful for their daily activities, such as e-payments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Today, about three in 10 households are still using analogue TV signals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We have put in place the Digital TV Assistance Scheme to help households switch to Digital TV and will continue to provide targeted assistance to the elderly, including organising briefings and demonstration sessions using both English and the vernacular languages.

sections.label: TeSA training places and funding
sections.summary: Since 2016 over 27,000 TeSA training places were taken up, most trainees placed, and TeSA will be scaled up with $145 million more funding.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: You have heard from the Minister that outcomes have been encouraging and, since its launch in 2016, more than 27,000 training places have been taken up or committed, greatly increasing the opportunities for workers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Every individual who has gone through TeSA’s Company Led Training programmes, as well as more than 90% of job seeking trainees from the Tech Immersion and Placement Programme have been successfully placed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We will scale up the TeSA initiatives with an additional $145 million of funding.

sections.label: TeSA additional training places
sections.summary: TeSA will provide an additional 20,000 training places by 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information and Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: First, TeSA will provide an additional 20,000 training places by 2020.

sections.label: Technology as enabler
sections.summary: In the digital transformation journey, technology is an enabler, not the end in mind.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, as we embark on our digital transformation journey, we are clear that technology is an enabler, not the end in mind.

sections.label: Media sector four Cs
sections.summary: Media sector efforts focus on four Cs: Content, Capabilities, Channels and Collaboration.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Our efforts for the media sector focus on four Cs: Content, Capabilities, Channels and Collaboration.

sections.label: HBO Asia collaboration
sections.summary: Collaboration with HBO Asia will open opportunities for Singaporeans to take on key production roles in HBO's upcoming productions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: For example, the collaboration with Home Box Office (HBO) Asia will open opportunities for Singaporeans to take on key production roles in HBO's upcoming productions.

sections.label: Series premiere second half 2018
sections.summary: Both series will premiere in the second half of 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Both series will premiere in the second half of 2018.

sections.label: Mediacorp commissions 11 student projects
sections.summary: Mediacorp has selected 11 student projects to commission, launching on Toggle later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Mediacorp has selected 11 student projects to commission, which will launch on Toggle later this year.

sections.label: Scheme expands to outside media professionals
sections.summary: From May this year, the scheme expands to support media professionals outside the media sector, such as manufacturing and retail.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: From May this year, we will expand the scheme to support media professionals outside the media sector, such as those who are employed in the manufacturing and retail sectors.

sections.label: Skills Framework for Media launch
sections.summary: IMDA and SkillsFuture Singapore are jointly developing the Skills Framework for Media, expected to launch in November 2018 covering about 140 media job roles.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: I earlier announced that IMDA and SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG) are jointly developing the Skills Framework for Media.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: This is expected to be launched in November 2018 and will cover about 140 media job roles in areas, such as games, broadcast and film.

sections.label: Tripartite Standard required for media grants
sections.summary: Starting 1 April 2018, organisations must adopt the Tripartite Standard to qualify for IMDA's media grants and funding for PSB content.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Starting from 1 April 2018, organisations must adopt the Tripartite Standard in order to qualify for IMDA's media grants and funding for PSB content.

sections.label: Toggle viewership growth since relaunch
sections.summary: Since its relaunch in April 2015, Toggle has seen viewership increase to more than eight million monthly video views today.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Since its relaunch in April 2015, Toggle has seen a steady increase in viewership to more than eight million monthly video views today.

sections.label: Mediacorp Toggle Originals launch
sections.summary: Using RIPPLE, Mediacorp will launch 34 new Toggle Originals this year, up from 13 last year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Using RIPPLE, Mediacorp will launch 34 new Toggle Originals this year, up from 13 released last year.

sections.label: NTC translation workshops and competitions
sections.summary: NTC worked with partners on translation workshops in three Mother Tongue languages and supported school translation competitions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Under this initiative, NTC worked with several partners to conduct translation workshops for students in all three Mother Tongue languages and supported schools in organising translation competitions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, in our multiracial community, raising translation standards is an important focus for the Government.

sections.label: Translation in multiracial Singapore
sections.summary: NTC and partners will persevere in the mission of getting translations correct in multicultural Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: There is also a Tamil proverb, "ஒன்றுபட்டால் உண்டு வாழ்வு ", which means "unity is strength".

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: And as I said in my COS speech in 2016, we are committed to getting our translations correct: "சரியான மொழிபெயர்ப்பே நமது கடப்பாடு ".

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: (In Mandarin):   In a multicultural and multiracial society like Singapore, translation plays an important role.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: It helps the Government better explain our policies, thereby benefiting our people and promoting understanding amongst the races.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: We are aware of the challenges we face as society and technology evolve.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: However, NTC, together with like-minded partners, will persevere in carrying on this meaningful and important mission, which is also of cultural significance.

sections.label: Revamped libraries under Masterplan
sections.summary: Five libraries were revamped and reopened under the Masterplan, with visitorship doubling on average.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Five libraries have been revamped and reopened under the Masterplan – Bedok Public Library, Bukit Panjang Public Library, Sengkang Public Library, Tampines Regional Library and Yishun Public Library.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Visitorship has doubled on average, and loans rose by over 40% at the Bukit Panjang and Sengkang libraries, compared to before the revamp.

sections.label: E-book loans and NLB digital reach
sections.summary: As of 2017, e-book loans rose 69% and NLB's digital reach grew to 34%.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: In fact, as of 2017, e-book loans have increased by 69%; NLB's digital reach has grown more than threefold, to 34%; and the NLB mobile app has been accessed three million times since its launch in October 2016.

sections.label: NLB digital readiness programmes
sections.summary: NLB will bring over 1,000 digital-readiness programmes yearly and partner IMDA to reach over 300,000 Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: To start, NLB will bring in more than 1,000 digital-readiness programmes for all ages every year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Dr Teo Ho Pin asked about the libraries' efforts in supporting and preparing Singaporeans for active ageing.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: I am pleased to share that NLB will partner IMDA to develop and deliver a suite of digital readiness services and extend the reach of digital readiness training to more than 300,000 Singaporeans over five years, 85% of whom are expected to be adults and seniors.

sections.label: Early READ reading interest
sections.summary: Through Early READ, 99% of educators and 92% of parents observed their children gained an interest in reading.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Through Early READ, 99% of educators and 92% of parents observed that their children have gained an interest in reading.

sections.label: NLB Act electronic publications deposit
sections.summary: NLB Act will be amended to require publishers to deposit electronic publications free of technological protection measures for access and preservation.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: Later this year, we will amend the NLB Act to require publishers to deposit electronic publications free of technological protection measures so that NLB can provide access to and preserve the documents.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: In preserving our national patrimony, NLB works closely with the community to preserve the rich heritage and culture that are embodied in our people.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We particularly would like to thank our Citizen Archivists for helping us transcribe, describe and make sense of some 27,000 images or pages in the past year.

sections.label: NAS building revamp Canning Rise
sections.summary: NAS will preserve at-risk collections and revamp its Canning Rise building to enhance archival facilities and create more public spaces.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: NAS will continue to preserve and make accessible our nation's at-risk collections and treasures, including microfilms and audio visual (AV) records.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We are, therefore, revamping the NAS building at Canning Rise to enhance its archival facilities and create more public spaces so that Singaporeans can enjoy our rich repository of treasures.

sections.label: Mainstream media viewership readership unchanged
sections.summary: Viewership and readership of mainstream media, Mediacorp and SPH, have not been reduced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: First, we need to understand that viewership and readership of mainstream media – Mediacorp, SPH – have not been reduced.

sections.label: Monetising online mainstream media
sections.summary: Mainstream media companies need a more effective way of monetising online despite overall readership and viewership numbers, as advertising revenue differs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The challenge that our mainstream media companies are faced with right now is that even though the overall readership, viewership numbers are there, we need to find a more effective way of monetising these online.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The advertising revenues on traditional platforms through your newspapers, TV, when you compare to the advertising revenue currently online, there is still a difference.

sections.label: SPH Mediacorp data analytics marketing
sections.summary: SPH and Mediacorp are using data analytics and more targeted communications and marketing, which is still a work-in-progress.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Both SPH and Mediacorp are looking at this using data analytics, using more targeted communications and marketing, and this is still a work-in-progress.

sections.label: Analogue TV signal households
sections.summary: About 30% of households still use the analogue TV signal, meaning a few hundred thousand households will not receive the TV signal next year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing
sentences.text: If I heard him correctly, 30% of households are still on the analogue TV signal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing
sentences.text: So, it translates to a few hundred thousand households which, come next year, will not receive the TV signal.

sections.label: MCI IMDA Mediacorp conversion communications
sections.summary: MCI and IMDA will work with Mediacorp, grassroots and community organisations on clear communications to help residents understand the conversion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Yes, I think the short answer is MCI, IMDA will work closely with the broadcaster Mediacorp.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We will also work closely with the grassroots organisations, the community organisations to make sure that we have clear, simple to understand communications that we can then roll out to help all our residents to understand how they can go through this conversion.
